name: Love at first bite
source:
Ryota, a second year highschool student, received a letter of confession from a girl one year lower than him. Little did he know, the girl is actually hiding a horrifying secret.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/681282]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
高中二年级生亮太收到了比自己低一年级的女生写的表白信。殊不知，这个女孩身上其实隐藏着一个惊天的秘密。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/681282]Newgrounds[/url]]
